clue.text: French word in title means relegated

indicators.note: in places the French word inside the word for a title

parts.note: a deed is a title document proving ownership of property
mot is the French for word

explanation.surface: A French term appearing in a heading turns out to mean demoted.
explanation.walkthrough: A deed is the legal document proving title to a property, not a heading.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe being moved down to a lower rank or division.

clue.text: Irritated by season being mild

indicators.note: by means next to, so the word for irritated stands beside the word for season

parts.note: to season can mean to temper or moderate, as in justice seasoned with mercy
ate, as in what ate at him, means troubled or irritated

explanation.surface: Someone annoyed by the time of year is nonetheless calm about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' sets ATE beside TEMPER. Season has an old sense of temper or moderate.
explanation.definitionFit: Temperate weather or behaviour is moderate, free of extremes.

clue.text: Give makeover to member of the clergy when visiting a politician

indicators.note: a visitor calls on a host, so the clergyman's title stands right beside the politician

parts.note: Rev, short for Reverend, is a title for a clergyman
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A vicar calling on the local MP decides to give the office a facelift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when visiting' sets REV beside A and MP; the clergyman calls on a politician.
explanation.definitionFit: To revamp something is to renovate or overhaul its appearance.

clue.text: Extinct beast old professor found at the pole

parts.note: a mast is a tall pole, as on a ship
a don is a university teacher, especially at Oxford or Cambridge

explanation.surface: Fossil remains of an ancient animal are discovered by an elderly academic at the North Pole.
explanation.definitionFit: The mastodon was a prehistoric elephant-like animal that died out thousands of years ago.

clue.text: Am ill with child?

parts.note: read AM as the hours before noon and ill as being sick, and the words describe the nausea of early pregnancy

explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a sick person asking if they are pregnant; cryptically AM is the morning and ill is sickness.
explanation.definitionFit: Nausea in the first months of pregnancy, often felt early in the day, is the condition described.

clue.text: Left address out for equine workers

indicators.note: out signals the letters are thrown out of order

explanation.surface: A stable hand has gone missing because the address was left off the letter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges L (left) with ADDRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Saddlers make and repair saddles and harness for horses.

clue.text: After end of disco, quit school

indicators.note: After places the word for quit behind the letter just taken
end of picks the final letter of the word disco

parts.note: to part is to leave or quit company

explanation.surface: Once the disco is over, a pupil decides to leave school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'end of' takes O from disco; 'After' puts PART behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: Op art is an art movement, a school of painting using optical illusion.

clue.text: Game spinster

definitions.meaning: a card game in which players pair cards and try not to be left holding the odd queen
an unmarried woman, in a dated and unkind expression

explanation.definitionFit: The card game is named after the dated term for a woman who never married.

clue.text: Endlessly observe Magritte being peaceful

indicators.note: Endlessly means the word for observe loses its final letter

parts.note: to see is to observe
Rene Magritte was the Belgian surrealist painter

explanation.surface: Gazing at a Magritte painting leaves the viewer calm.
explanation.walkthrough: René Magritte was the Belgian surrealist; only his first name is used, the surname is the distraction.
explanation.definitionFit: Serene means calm and untroubled, a synonym.

clue.text: Adder taking sleep around furry creature

indicators.note: around turns the whole assembly to read backwards
taking means the snake's name takes in the word for sleep

parts.note: a nap is a short sleep

explanation.surface: A snake swallows a sleeping furry animal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' turns the whole assembly ADNAPDER backwards, not just the sleep; the snake swallowing the animal is pure surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The red panda is a small russet-furred mammal of the Himalayas.

clue.text: Illness? Take time off to moan

indicators.note: Take time off means the letter for time is removed

parts.note: a complaint is an illness or ailment

explanation.surface: An ill worker takes leave from work in order to grumble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' (with 'Take') removes T from COMPLAINT.
explanation.definitionFit: To complain is to grumble or express dissatisfaction.

clue.text: Permit prince to be vicious

parts.note: to let is to permit
Prince Hal is Shakespeare's young Henry V

explanation.surface: A ruler allows the young heir to behave cruelly.
explanation.walkthrough: HAL is Prince Hal, the future Henry V in Shakespeare's history plays.
explanation.definitionFit: Lethal means deadly; vicious can mean capable of causing serious harm.

clue.text: Soft ground around is good for reptile

indicators.note: around means the word for ground goes round the letter for soft

parts.note: terrain is ground or land
P, for piano, means soft in music

explanation.surface: A muddy riverbank makes a good home for a turtle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' puts TERRAIN round P (piano, musical soft).
explanation.definitionFit: A terrapin is a small freshwater turtle, a type of reptile.

clue.text: Diva's bloomers

definitions.meaning: belonging to Judy Garland, the singer and film star
flowers woven into wreaths, things made of blooms

explanation.definitionFit: Judy Garland's name with a possessive gives the plural of a ring of flowers.

clue.text: Artist passed over bananas to sick old beast

indicators.note: passed over in a down clue means the letters are flipped upwards

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
bananas is slang for crazy, mad
ill means sick

explanation.surface: An artist hands bananas to an ailing old animal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'passed over' turns RA into AR.
explanation.definitionFit: An armadillo is an armoured American mammal, an animal.

clue.text: When thawed, something wet I care to drink

definitions.text: When thawed, something wet I care to drink

indicators.note: thawed means the letters melt and reform in a new order

explanation.surface: Once it has melted, the dessert becomes a drink worth caring about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thawed' rearranges WET I CARE, and the whole clue describes the frozen treat melting into a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Water ice is a frozen sorbet that, once thawed, becomes a liquid to sip.

clue.text: Jug knocked over by irate doctor — such language!

indicators.note: knocked over means the jug is turned upside down, reading backwards
doctor means tamper with, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An angry doctor knocks a jug over and swears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked over' gives GUJ; 'doctor' rearranges IRATE as ERATI. 'such language!' looks like a reaction to swearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Gujarati, here spelt with an E, is the Indo-Aryan tongue of Gujarat.

clue.text: Strange coin in pot is a fabulous thing to behold

indicators.note: in places the shuffled letters inside the word for pot

parts.note: an urn is a pot or vase

indicators.note: Strange signals the letters of coin are rearranged

explanation.surface: Finding an odd coin inside a pot would be a marvellous sight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strange' gives NICO; the definition stretches to 'to behold', since a unicorn is something only seen in fable.
explanation.definitionFit: The unicorn is a creature of fable and legend, never seen in reality.

clue.text: Footballers resort to untruths

parts.note: Goa is an Indian state famous for beach holidays
lies are untruths

explanation.surface: Players accused of cheating start telling lies.
explanation.definitionFit: Goalies are goalkeepers, players in football.

clue.text: Herb draco malfoy initially scattered round a muggle's head

indicators.note: round means the shuffled name goes around the next two letters
scattered signals the letters are thrown into a new order
head takes the first letter of muggle
initially takes the first letter of malfoy

explanation.surface: A Harry Potter villain spills herbs over the head of a non-magical person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scattered' rearranges DRACO into CARDO, and 'round' puts it around A plus M ('muggle's head'); 'initially' adds M from malfoy at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Cardamom is an aromatic spice used in cooking, loosely a herb.

clue.text: Turn away rubbish

definitions.meaning: to decline or reject, the verb
waste matter, the noun stressed on its first syllable

explanation.definitionFit: The verb meaning to decline and the noun meaning waste share a spelling but differ in stress.

clue.text: Continental bed let out wee

parts.note: lit is the French word for bed

indicators.note: out signals the letters of let are rearranged

explanation.surface: A guest in a European hotel finds the bed has been let out to someone else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges LET as TLE. Wee is Scottish for small.
explanation.definitionFit: Wee is a Scots word meaning small or tiny.

clue.text: Walk from market up to park

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word for market is read bottom to top

parts.note: a mart is a market
P is the abbreviation for parking, a car park

explanation.surface: A stroll from the shops up to the local park.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns MART into TRAM. P is the map and road-sign symbol for parking.
explanation.definitionFit: To tramp is to walk heavily or over a long distance.

clue.text: Such an airline won't feed you for fifty florins, possibly

definitions.text: Such an airline won't feed you

indicators.note: possibly signals the letters may be arranged otherwise

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A budget carrier offers no meals, even for fifty old coins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges L (fifty) with FLORINS. A florin was a British two-shilling coin.
explanation.definitionFit: A no-frills airline is a budget carrier with no complimentary extras such as meals.

clue.text: Genuine Roman

definitions.meaning: a Latin expression, as the Romans spoke it, meaning in good faith

explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase, literally in good faith, means real or authentic.

clue.text: Precious stuff symbolically placed in centre of cage

definitions.text: Precious stuff symbolically placed in centre of cage

parts.words: Precious stuff symbolically placed in centre of cage
parts.note: the chemical symbol of a precious metal is Ag, which is the middle of the word cage

explanation.walkthrough: The chemical symbol Ag sits at the centre of the word 'cage'.
explanation.definitionFit: A precious metal whose chemical symbol is Ag, from Latin argentum.

clue.text: Navy takes royal engineers round fish

indicators.note: round means the word for royal engineers goes round the letter for navy

parts.note: sappers are soldiers of the Royal Engineers, the British army's engineering corps

explanation.surface: Sailors and army engineers surround a catch of fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' puts SAPPERS around N.
explanation.definitionFit: Snappers are a family of predatory sea fish.
